note: the mask contour segments keep their edge order whatever side the inside corner is on, so outlines no longer chain into closed rings with the inside on their left, caught by MaskOpsTests.ringHasTwoClosedOutlinesOnItsCircles
contour crossing ignores the level and takes the midpoint, so a 0 to 0.75 edge crosses at 1/2 instead of 2/3, caught by MaskOpsTests.crossingInterpolatesTheLevel
mask contours drop the segment cap, so a checkerboard past maxContourSegments builds every link instead of throwing, caught by MaskOpsTests.checkerboardOverTheSegmentCapThrows
the contour pre-scan skips cells whose only crossing is a horizontal edge, so outlines break open and lose points, caught by MaskOpsTests
